systems.name: GWorld - GURPS 4e
systems.summary: A GURPS 4th Edition game system implementing the Basic Set rules for Foundry VTT v14.

modules.name: Sargas Time Bomb
modules.summary: Adventure clocks for Pathfinder 2e: progress, countdowns, threats, factions, corruption, alarms, projects and weather fronts.

modules.name: Sargas Through the Ages
modules.summary: A GM-managed custom world calendar with campaign notes and an expandable timeline of Ages and events.

modules.name: Sargas Encounter Builder
modules.summary: A Pathfinder 2e GM workspace for party profiles, XP budgets, creature browsing and balanced encounter generation.

modules.name: Sargas Investigation Board
modules.summary: A collaborative pinboard where players pin clues and string them together to work cases as a party.

modules.name: Sargas Dice Set
modules.summary: Animated 3D dice for every roll in hand-designed Sargas, Oracle, Spiral Set and Classic styles.

modules.name: Sargas Visual Automation
modules.summary: Plays and automates JB2A animations directly, without Sequencer or Automated Animations.

modules.name: Sargas Wondrous Spellbook
modules.summary: A spellbook creator and slot-fill tool for the Pathfinder Second Edition system.

modules.name: Sargas Compendium Manager
modules.summary: Shares one compendium library between two Pathfinder 2e worlds on the same Foundry installation.

modules.name: Sargas Victory Counter
modules.summary: Shared, always-visible progress and threshold tracks for any game system (Foundry v14).

modules.name: Sargas Victory Counter (Foundry v13)
modules.summary: The Foundry v13 build of Victory Counter: shared progress and threshold tracks for any game system.

modules.name: Sargas GURPS Compendium Content
modules.summary: GURPS books' text and statistics overlaid onto the GWorld system's compendia, for one table whose members own the books.

modules.name: Sargas SoundFx Library
modules.summary: A library of sound effects for soundboards, forked from CDeenen's Material Foundry original and maintained for Foundry v13/v14.

modules.name: Cosmere Infusions
modules.summary: Tracks Radiant infusions for the Cosmere RPG system: Investiture infused into objects, characters or yourself by surges, drained each round, topped up, reclaimed and ended.

modules.name: Sargas - Mythic Powers
modules.summary: Pathfinder Second Edition mythic power, granted by the GM one character at a time.

modules.name: Sargas PF2e GM Screen
modules.summary: An interactive GM screen for Pathfinder 2e Remaster: rules reference, live party overview, and treasure & loot tools.
